record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: waiting rows stay one line without a waits-on note, task detail still lists Depends on, and the updated suites pass through the real dashboard entry point.

## Approach

1. Run the dashboard app pilot covering a waiting task with several unfinished dependencies at typical widths; assert the title cell has no `waits on`, remains a single line, and detail still exposes Depends on links.
2. Run the focused pytest slice for tasks/app waits-on/title_cell/waiting_row (and tmux needle if applicable).
3. Record check-run evidence via verify-work; do not change product code unless a gap appears — then amend `drop-row-waits-on` or open a finding.
record.subject: verify-waits-on-compact
